[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on how to ensure team members are comfortable with the idea of virtual coffee breaks, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Discuss and agree: Hold a team meeting or send out a survey to gauge interest.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use a comfortable platform: Select an easy-to-use video conferencing platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep it optional: Make participation clear as optional.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Start small: Begin with a small group to test the waters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Encourage participation: Share fun icebreaker questions or topics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Be flexible: Adjust the format or schedule as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Lead by example: Actively participate and engage with others.
